sloka: एवमाश्वास्य वैदेहीं हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।गमनाय मतिं कृत्वा वैदेहीं पुनरब्रवीत् ।। ५.३९.४७।।।।
transliteration: evamāśvāsya vaidehīṁ hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।gamanāya matiṁ kṛtvā vaidehīṁ punarabravīt ।। 5.39.47।।।।

translations.english: Having thus consoled Vaidehi, Hanuman, son of the Windgod resolved to depart. Once again he spoke to Vadehi:
